profile.headline: Software Engineer at Caterpillar Inc.
profile.summary: I have a solid background with Software Engineering with my projects and Masters experience. Through my coursework and thesis experience I have gained strong programming and problem solving skills. I can implement websites with my knowledge of scripted languages such as php, html and MySQL as database server. I have experience in managing large datasets from my training model.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•      Fine tuning previous Unity 3D projects towards latest version and bug fixing
•      Automated comparison of real-world web source image vs Caterpillar parts using Search Engine API and generative AI 
•	Worked with Azure storage blob for stp, zip, asb file uploads from backend
•       Fine tune automation process of uploading raw csv file data towards the Azure Database
•	Updated Unity 3D object visualizer build communicating with frontend website
•       Delivered AR/VR application with Unity and C# Programing for Caterpillar's simualtion projects
•	Applied Multiplayer behavior within the AR/VR simulation training with Photon and Netcode
•	Providing on automation program for better client usage
•	Improving better peformance on Maya software plugins for CGI artists
•	Working on full stack software utilizing Power Apps and Azure SQL Database
positions.insights: Microsoft Power Automate, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +11 skills

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Supported undergraduate students learning basic data structure knowledge during 2 course computer science sequence
•	Prioritized constructive feedback over letter grades while assessing assignments of the 40 student class each semester
•	Emphasized communication with students and delivered as many suggestions as possible which has strengthened my ability to lead a team of computer scientists

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Supported undergraduate students learning basic data structure knowledge during two course computer science sequence. Prioritized constructive feedback over letter grades while assessing assignments of the 40-student class each semester. Lead a team of computer science students by prioritizing open communication and delivering continuous feedback.
